faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our premium IPTV services.

q1.a: We support all devices: Smart TVs (Samsung, LG, Sony), Android boxes, Firestick, Apple TV, Smartphones, and Mag boxes.

q2.q: How long does it take to activate?
q2.a: Most accounts are activated within 15-30 minutes after payment. You will receive an email with all the instructions.

q3.a: No, a VPN is not required as we use advanced anti-freeze technology. However, you can use one if you prefer.

q4.q: Can I use it on multiple devices?
q4.a: Our standard plans support one device at a time. Contact us for multi-room packages if you need simultaneous streams.
